messages:
marie: Heads up — TridentRetail is hitting intermittent 504s on /v1/embeddings when seq_len spikes. CS just flagged it as an SLA risk. Need a short mitigation plan + owner. Logs below.

marie: ```
2026-02-11T14:12:03Z ERROR embed-service request_id=abc123 timeout during batch exec
2026-02-11T14:12:04Z WARN kvcache eviction spikes=12 model=embed-xl-v2
```

leo: On it. Early signal looks like continuous-batcher timeouts when a few large requests enter the same batch. embed-xl-v2's memory/KV churn seems to blow past our per-batch window.

leo: Short mitigation: router-level fallback to embed-large-v1 for Trident's customer-id, and cap max_batch_size -> 8. That should remove the tail.

marie: Agreed. We need someone to own the routing override + a quick canary rollout. @oliver?

oliver: I can take the canary. Will open a small PR to add a per-customer routing override flag and a policy that maps TridentRetail -> embed-large-v1. Targeting 30 min for PR + tests, 1h for canary monitor.

oliver: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/router/pull/372 (working branch)

oliver: Config diff (will be in PR):
```yaml
per_customer_overrides:
  trident_retail_id:
    preferred_model: embed-large-v1
    max_batch_size: 8
```

anya: +1. When canary is up I'll disable large-batch aggregation for that customer for 24h and watch p99/p95. If p95 > 350ms I'll page.

sam: Thanks — I told Trident we'll have a mitigation in ~1h. They're pressing for ETA on a full root-cause fix.

leo: Full remediation requires a couple changes in the KV eviction logic and improved memory accounting in the runtime. Estimate ~3 business days (code + CI + staged rollout).

marie: OK. So plan: (1) oliver deploys per-customer fallback canary -> asap, (2) anya monitors and escalates if regressions, (3) leo owns the root-cause PR (ETA 3d). CS will keep Trident updated with the timeline.

oliver: Created PR 1760012600 to add the override and a canary job. Requesting @leo review.

leo: Reviewing now, should be quick — only routing config + small feature flag.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for router@commit:abcdeff (canary id: canary-372).

oliver: Canary live on us-west-2 for 10% traffic to Trident.

anya: Monitoring: initial p95 went from 420ms -> 190ms after canary. No errors in first 15m. Keeping alert thresholds active.

sam: Passing this to Trident: mitigation is live in canary, early signal positive. CS will confirm after 1h.

marie: Great. @leo please post the root-cause PR link when ready. Keep updates concise here (one-line status). :thumbsup:
